title: Omuziki Ogutambuza Ensozi
intro: Ogenda okubikkula emboozi y’omuddu wa Allah ow’ekitalo. Mu nsi ey’ababaka n’abafuzi, ekifaananyi kino kyaweebwa omukisa n’ekitabo eky’obwakatonda, eddoboozi ery’amaanyi, n’amaanyi ku kyuma. Nga bw’osoma obukodyo, osobola okuzuula ani ono ayinza okuba?
clues: Nnali muweereza wa Allah eyaweebwa ekitabo eky’enjawulo.
Nnalina eddoboozi eddungi, era okutendereza kwange kwali kwagala nnyo ne kiba nti n’obusozi n’ebinyonyi byanneegattako.
Nnayolekagana n’omuntu gwe nnali nvuganya naye ow’entiisa mu lutalo olwali lumanyiddwa ennyo, era wadde nga nnali mutono, nnawangula.
Ekyuma kyanfuula ekigonvu, ne kinsobozesa okukola ebyokulwanyisa n’emikono gyange.
Nnafuulibwa omufuzi w’eggwanga eddene, era amagezi gange mu kusala emisango gaali gamanyiddwa nnyo.
Omwana wange naye nga nnabbi, yakkirizibwa okufuga empewo n’amajinni.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
